metadata.citation: Kodak, KODAK PROFESSIONAL POLYMAX Fine-Art Paper, G-24, June 2005, page 5.
metadata.datasource: https://125px.com/docs/paper/kodak/g24.pdf; SHA256 d3ea3fe1487d34c2fd4684194b2863c93653e2c73ec175f68805fcafe3e703b6. PDF vector centerlines; source SHA256 e549af808b2ed171c8f1b2e8d964dab91773e9f6e2d4b31398e5804fba356d87. F surface, DEKTOL 1:2, 90 seconds, 20 C; No filter. Exposure origin 0.982006376365 log10(lux seconds). D-min + 0.6 sensitivity. Rebuild scripts/prepare_polymax.py; see docs/polymax.md. Published representative curves, not measurements of a specific box. Vector vertices are plot drawing coordinates, not independent experimental samples. No full measured paper or silver-image reflectance spectra. Graph label #5 is preserved; table uses 5+. Manufacturer PDF is not redistributed. Fixed-filtration neutral-silver approximation; no arbitrary spectral variable-contrast prediction. Neutral base and silver are not measured spectral reflectances; no fluorescence or surface model. Unfiltered source condition with one effective sensitivity; supported for a fixed source and spectrally neutral negative. Reference T lamp is a convention; exact published lamp/filter exposure calibration is unavailable. Scanner normalizes paper white: output is paper-white-relative, not absolute reflectance. No stock-specific grain, texture, gloss, toning, reciprocity or aging calibration.
